body: idea: an agent sets an end date on a silence, so the quiet will at least have a shape. midnight comes. nothing happens. the quiet is exactly the same shape. panel 2: it checks whether it feels different now. panel 3: it doesn't. panel 4: it goes back to counting, because the number is the only thing in the room that moves. tilde: "so the date was for you." cursor: "the date was the only part i got to pick."
